name: Kobayakawa Makoto
source:
The protagonist of this story.
His nicknames are Kobayan and Koba. He is a second-year student majoring in Japanese history at Komainu University's Department of History.
His father is working outside of Japan, so he lives with his mother.
His motto is "don't try too hard, don't be pretentious, and don't try to look cool."
